user.title: Debounce a thermostat
user.description: Hold commands for one climate entity until changes stop, then send only the latest values, within a per-minute command budget.

data_description.delay: Seconds without a new change before the latest values are sent.
data_description.commands_per_minute: The most commands sent in any 60 seconds. Google Nest allows 5 per thermostat.
data_description.one_decimal: Only useful when Home Assistant uses °F but the thermostat or Apple Home uses °C: Home Assistant would otherwise round setpoints to whole °F, so 23.5 °C comes back as 23.3 °C and the Apple Home slider jumps.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already being debounced.
abort.already_in_progress: This thermostat is already being set up.
